s: puM, apahananaM । apakfzwArTApopasargAt hanaDAtorBAve GaY hasya GaH nasya taH । apakfzwamftyuPalakazyApAraH । apahanyate iti vyutpattyA apapUrvvaka hanaDAtorBAve GaYpratyayena nizpannaH ॥
v: pu॰ apa--hana--BAve GaY । apakfzwahanane duzwahetukamaraRe ca ।
m: warding off, ŚBr. (cf. Pāṇ. iii, 3, 81, Sch.)
a: अपघातः — 1 Striking or cutting off, warding off, preventing. --2 Killing. --3 A violent death, any evil accident proving fatal.

v: pu॰ apahanti apa + hana--Rvul । vinASake । “jijYAsA tadarapaGAtake hetO” sA॰ kA॰ pAWAntaram ।
tri॰ apa + hana--karttari Rini । apahananakarttari striyAM NIp ।
m: अप-घातिन् mfn. id. See अप-√ हन्.
अप-घाटिला f. a kind of musical instrument (cf. अव-घटरिका), Lāṭy.

s: puM, (apahftya militvA viyujyate, apa + han + “apaGano'Nga”-miti pARinisUtreRa ap hasTAne Ga .) avayavaH । aNgaM । ityamaraH । (“GfRiBirapaGanErGaGaravyaktaGozAn” । iti sUryyaSatake .)
v: pu॰ apahanyate saMhatya karmma kftvA viyujyate apa + hanaap GanAdeSaH । SarIre, hastAdyavayave ca । SarIrAdi hi puruzopaBogAya praTamaM saMhatya tattatkarmma nizpAdya BogAdfzwakzaye punarviyujyate iti tasya taTAtvam । dehAdeH saMhatya kAritvaM ca pAtaYjalAdO darSitaM yaTA । “parArTaM saMhatya kAritvAditi” pAta॰ । itarasAhityenArTakriyAkAritvaM saMhatyakAritA, saMhananaYca AramBakasaMyogaBedaH । taTA ca dehAdikaM parArTaM (svetarasya BogApavargaPalakam,) saMhatatvAt SayyAsanAdivadityanumAnaprayogaH । ataeva sAMKyasUtre “saMhataparArTatvAditi” saMhantfsidDiruktA । saMhatAnAM dehA dInAM svetarasya BogAdiPalakatvAt saMGAtAtiriktaH puruzo'numIyate nahi acetanAnAM dehAdInAM svataH saMGAtaH samBavati ataH saMGAtasidDaye puruzasidDiriti samuditArTaH । “saMyogASca viBAgAntA” ityukteH saMyogaBedarUpasaMhananasyAvaSyaM viyogAntatvAt dehAdInAM tadavayavAnAYca krameRAramBakasaMyoganASena parasparaviyoga ityato'NgAderavaSyaviyogavattvAt taTAtvam ataeva “antavanta ime dehA nityasyoktAH SarIriRa” iti gItAyAmAramBakasaMyoganASapUrvvakaparasparaviyogena nASa uktaH । “lOhodGanaGanaskanDA lalitApaGanAM striyamiti” BawwiH । apagatoGanomeGo yasmAt prA॰ ba॰ vA gatalopaH । meGAvaraRaSUnye tri॰ vA gatalopABAve apagataGano'pyuktArTe ।
m: 1. अप-घन m. (√ हन्), (Pāṇ. iii, 3, 81) a limb or member (as a hand or foot), Naiṣ.
a: अपघनः — [अपहन्यते संहत्य कर्म कृत्वा वियुज्यते, हन्-अप्-घनादेशः P. III 3. 77]. A limb or member of the body, as a hand or foot (अपघनोंऽगम् III. 3. 81; अंगं शरीरावयवः स च न सर्वं किं तु पाणिः पादश्चेत्याहुः Sk. and Kāśikā.); but it is also used in the sense of ‘the body’; लौहोद्घनघनस्कंधा ललितापघनां स्त्रियं Bk. 7. 62 (where the commentators take अपघन to mean the body itself). --a. Free from the obstruction of clouds, cloudless.

k.v: अङ्गं प्रतीकोऽवयवोऽपघनोऽथ कलेवरम्. गात्रं वपुः संहननं शरीरं वर्ष्म विग्रहः॥

m: अप-√ घट् Caus. -घाटयति, to shut up.
